difficultyRationale: Tests the class-over-interface precedence rule for inherited concrete instance methods and interface defaults.
prompt: A superclass provides a concrete instance method `run()`, and an implemented interface provides a default `run()` with the same signature. Which implementation is inherited by the subclass if it declares no `run()`?
explanation: A concrete method inherited from a class takes precedence over an interface default method with the same signature. This is commonly summarized as 'class wins'.

options.explanation: Defaults do not override an applicable concrete class method.
Class methods take precedence over interface defaults.

options.text: The subclass must always override run() or compilation fails.
options.explanation: There is no conflict requiring an override when a concrete class method already resolves it.

options.text: Both implementations run in declaration order.

references.title: JLS 8.4.8.4 Inheriting Methods with Override-Equivalent Signatures
